content.tex: A INVESTIGATION (QUESTIONS 1 to 7)
CIRCLES AND REGIONS (30 marks)
You are advised to spend no more than 50 minutes on this part.
This is an investigation into the number of regions formed by drawing lines on a circle.

parts.text: Secants A secant is a straight line that intersects a circle at two points and extends outside the circle. In this investigation: • each secant must cut every other secant • only 2 secants may intersect at any point • secants must not intersect on the circumference of the circle. The diagram shows the number of regions with 2 secants drawn on a circle.

content.tex: Secants
A secant is a straight line that intersects a circle at two points and extends outside the circle.

In this investigation: \(\bullet\) each secant must cut every other secant \(\bullet\) only 2 secants may intersect at any point \(\bullet\) secants must not intersect on the circumference of the circle.
The diagram shows the number of regions with 2 secants drawn on a circle.
